# CLI reference

Plain-text help also at [`_build/cli-reference.txt`](../_build/cli-reference.txt).

Machine-readable flags:

| Command | Flag | Output |
|---------|------|--------|
| `preflight` | `--json` | Preflight checks JSON |
| `test` | `--json` | JSON on stdout (logs on stderr) |
| `test` | `--full` | Extended snapshot API checks |
| `status` | `--json` | Node readiness JSON |

```text
hypercluster — end-to-end Kubernetes cluster lifecycle wrapper for Kubespray.

Usage:  hypercluster [OPTIONS] <command> [ARGS]

Commands:
  init              Clone Kubespray and generate inventory + group_vars
                    Use init --wizard to create cluster.conf interactively first
                    Use init --profile <name> to copy config/profiles/<name>.conf.example
  wizard            Interactive cluster.conf generator (no existing config required)
  preflight         Verify local tools and SSH connectivity to all nodes (--json)
  deploy            Full cluster deployment (preflight + init + cluster.yml)
  scale             Add worker nodes listed in cluster.conf (scale.yml)
  upgrade           Upgrade Kubernetes to the version in cluster.conf
  remove-node       Drain and remove a single node
  fetch-kubeconfig  Copy admin.conf from the first control-plane node
  merge-kubeconfig  Merge the cluster kubeconfig into ~/.kube/config
  install-kubevirt  Install KubeVirt operator + CDI (also runs after deploy if KUBEVIRT_ENABLED=true)
  test              Run platform smoke tests (k3s path; optional --full, --json)
  destroy           Tear down the cluster (reset.yml or k3s uninstall)
  vms               List KubeVirt VMs + template catalog (--json)
  vm create         Validate template and preview VM create (--template, --name, --json)
  workloads         List pods and services (--json)
  discover          Discover VMs/hosts (libvirt, Proxmox, VMware, ssh-scan, csv) (--json)
  status            Node status (optional --json for machine-readable output)
  health            Connect + report nodes, pods, services, VMs (--json; --with-test for k3s smoke)
  unlock            Remove stale per-cluster lock after a crash
  lab setup         Secondary disk + memory tune (from cluster.conf LAB_* vars)
  forge-handoff     Emit JSON handoff for Forge Day-2 import (--json)
  lab storage       Mount LAB_SECONDARY_DISK, patch local-path, StorageClass
  lab tune          Scale down HA replicas on single-node labs (--restore to undo)

Options:
  -c <file>   Path to cluster config (default: ./cluster.conf)
  -f          Force overwrite of existing inventory
  -n          Dry run — print what would be executed, skip actual changes
  -v          Verbose Ansible output
  -V          Show version
  -h          Show this help
```
